turns.content: I'm in my final year of uni and I'm so behind. I haven't been able to concentrate for weeks.
Final year pressure is intense. What's making it hard to concentrate?
I don't know. I sit down to work and my mind just goes blank. I've been staring at the same chapter for three days.
That kind of mental block can be really frustrating. Are you sleeping and eating okay?
Not really. I've lost about 5kg in the last month. I just don't see the point of eating. Or honestly of finishing the degree.
When you say you don't see the point — do you mean the degree specifically, or is that feeling broader?
Broader. I don't see the point of a lot of things lately. I used to have plans for after graduation. Now I can't imagine a future at all.
Not being able to imagine a future is something I take seriously. Are you having thoughts of ending your life?
I've thought about it. Specifically. I don't know if I'd do it but I've thought about how. That scares me.
